entries.en: The researchers measured the bandgap of the new semiconductor.
entries.zh: 研究人员测量了这种新型半导体的能带隙。

entries.en: Only a few harvestable pumpkins remained beneath the tangled vines.
entries.zh: 缠绕的藤蔓下面只剩几个可以收获的南瓜。

entries.en: In the diagram, the structure extends posteriorly from the central joint.
entries.zh: 图中，这个结构从中央关节向后延伸。

entries.en: The bowl has delicate underglaze decoration around its rim.
entries.zh: 这只碗的碗沿有精细的釉下装饰。

entries.en: The discussion included both hetero and gay couples.
entries.zh: 讨论中既有异性恋伴侣，也有同性恋伴侣。

entries.en: Nobody remembered the advertisement's tagline, but everyone recalled the dog.
entries.zh: 没人记得那则广告的宣传词，但人人都记得那条狗。

entries.en: The committed consumerist dismissed her proposal to buy fewer things.
entries.zh: 那位坚定的消费主义者不屑于她少买东西的提议。

entries.en: Rainwater collected in the lowest corner of the carpark.
entries.zh: 雨水积在停车场最低处的角落里。

entries.en: Her reappointment pleased colleagues who valued continuity in the department.
entries.zh: 她的连任让重视部门工作延续性的同事们很高兴。

entries.en: The gymnast landed a backflip without stepping off the mat.
entries.zh: 体操运动员完成后空翻落地，没有踏出垫子。

entries.en: The seminar examined the chronotope of the journey in the novel.
entries.zh: 研讨课探讨了小说中旅程的时空体。

entries.en: An old bullwhip hung beside the rancher's dusty hat.
entries.zh: 一条旧赶牛鞭挂在牧场主落满灰尘的帽子旁。

entries.en: In her fantasyland, the library stayed open all night.
entries.zh: 在她的幻想世界里，图书馆通宵开放。

entries.en: He chose pneumatology as the subject of his theology dissertation.
entries.zh: 他选择圣灵论作为神学学位论文的主题。

entries.en: The course connects pathophysiology with observations from clinical case studies.
entries.zh: 这门课把病理生理学与临床案例中的观察联系起来。

entries.en: The team used a codename until the product was announced.
entries.zh: 在产品公布之前，团队一直使用一个代号。

entries.en: The bendy ruler fitted easily inside her small pencil case.
entries.zh: 那把柔韧的尺子轻松放进了她的小铅笔盒。

entries.en: She discovered her preferred subspecialty during a hospital placement.
entries.zh: 她在医院实习期间找到了自己最喜欢的分科。

entries.en: The report questions the assumptions behind the government's deregulatory programme.
entries.zh: 报告质疑了政府解除管制方案背后的假设。

entries.en: He grew chippy whenever anyone questioned his qualifications.
entries.zh: 只要有人质疑他的资历，他就变得很暴躁。

entries.en: The novel follows a musician living with an untreatable illness.
entries.zh: 这部小说讲述了一位身患不治之症的音乐家的生活。

entries.en: The veteran funnyman surprised the audience with a serious monologue.
entries.zh: 那位资深滑稽演员的一段严肃独白让观众很意外。

entries.en: As a civvy, he no longer had to salute his former commander.
entries.zh: 作为平民，他不必再向以前的指挥官敬礼。

entries.meaningZh: 小伙子；家伙〔英式旧时口语〕
entries.en: A cheerful chappie offered to carry our bags upstairs.
entries.zh: 一个快活的小伙子主动提出帮我们把包搬上楼。

entries.en: We played foosball while waiting for the rain to stop.
entries.zh: 我们一边玩桌上足球，一边等雨停。

entries.en: A tall pillar blocked my sightline to the left of the stage.
entries.zh: 一根高柱子挡住了我望向舞台左侧的视线。

entries.en: The diagram depicts a multicenter network rather than a single central hub.
entries.zh: 图中展示的是一个多中心网络，而不是单一中央枢纽。

entries.en: The children listened raptly as the puppeteer lowered his voice.
entries.zh: 木偶表演者压低声音时，孩子们全神贯注地听着。

entries.en: She peered blearily at the clock beside her bed.
entries.zh: 她睡眼惺忪地看了看床边的时钟。

entries.en: The incongruence between his cheerful words and tense expression worried me.
entries.zh: 他欢快的话语与紧张的表情并不协调，这让我担心。

entries.en: They saved for two years before making the downpayment.
entries.zh: 他们存了两年钱才支付那笔首付款。

entries.en: The laboratory report identified three seropositive samples for further analysis.
entries.zh: 实验室报告列出了三个需进一步分析的血清反应阳性样本。

entries.meaningZh: 年轻男子〔西班牙语借词〕
entries.en: The story begins with a muchacho arriving at the village inn.
entries.zh: 故事从一位年轻男子来到村里的客栈开始。

entries.en: Each resident has a lockable cupboard beside the shared kitchen.
entries.zh: 每位住户在共用厨房旁都有一个可上锁的橱柜。

entries.en: Negotiators disagreed about the timetable for denuclearization.
entries.zh: 谈判者对无核化的时间表意见不一。

entries.en: The site is archaeologically important despite its unremarkable appearance.
entries.zh: 这个遗址虽然看起来平平无奇，却具有重要的考古价值。

entries.en: The franchisor supplied signs and training to the new shop.
entries.zh: 特许经营权授予者为新店提供了招牌和培训。

entries.en: Our dance teacher ended the class with a lively merengue.
entries.zh: 舞蹈老师用一支活泼的梅伦格舞结束了课程。

entries.en: The punky wood crumbled when I pressed it with my thumb.
entries.zh: 我用拇指一按，那块朽软的木头就碎了。

entries.en: The exercise asks us to imagine a massless rope.
entries.zh: 这道练习要求我们设想一根没有质量的绳子。

entries.en: A coachload of visitors arrived just before the museum closed.
entries.zh: 博物馆快关门时，来了一整辆长途汽车的游客。

entries.en: Her essay explores the inseparability of language and cultural memory.
entries.zh: 她的文章探讨了语言与文化记忆的不可分离性。

entries.en: The superimposition of two photographs created a ghostly double image.
entries.zh: 两张照片叠加后，形成了幽灵般的重影。

entries.en: He adjusted the finderscope before looking through the main telescope.
entries.zh: 他先调好寻星镜，再通过主望远镜观察。

entries.en: The cheesemaker invited us to taste a recently matured batch.
entries.zh: 干酪制造者请我们品尝一批刚熟成的干酪。

entries.en: The committee struggled to reconcile the two conflictive accounts.
entries.zh: 委员会努力调和两种相互矛盾的说法。

entries.en: The majordomo checked the guest list before opening the doors.
entries.zh: 男管家在开门前核对了宾客名单。

entries.en: The policy's implementer requested clearer instructions from the ministry.
entries.zh: 这项政策的实施者要求部里提供更明确的指示。

entries.en: A teletype rattled in the corner of the old newsroom.
entries.zh: 一台电传打字机在旧新闻编辑室的角落里咔嗒作响。

entries.en: She arranged thin apple slices inside the dehydrator.
entries.zh: 她把苹果薄片摆放在脱水机里。

entries.en: The ceremony had a unitive purpose despite the participants' differences.
entries.zh: 尽管参与者存在分歧，这场仪式仍以促进团结为目的。

entries.en: A quick deke drew the defender away from the goal.
entries.zh: 一个快速的假动作把防守队员引离了球门。

entries.en: The redesigned shell performs better aerodynamically than the original.
entries.zh: 从空气动力学性能看，重新设计的外壳比原来的更好。

entries.en: The contessa received her guests beneath a faded family portrait.
entries.zh: 伯爵夫人在一幅褪色的家族肖像下接待来宾。

entries.en: A snowcat carried the repair crew up the mountain.
entries.zh: 一辆雪地履带车把维修人员送上山。

entries.en: The historian described the conflict as a fratricidal struggle.
entries.zh: 历史学家把这场冲突描述为同族相残的斗争。

entries.en: The reformers favoured incrementalism over a sudden institutional overhaul.
entries.zh: 改革者主张渐进主义，而不是突然全面改造制度。

entries.en: The image shows a single nanowire crossing the tiny gap.
entries.zh: 图像显示一根纳米线横跨那个微小的间隙。

entries.en: The chemist compared two models of the chiral molecule.
entries.zh: 化学家比较了这个手性分子的两个模型。

entries.en: His fans displayed a cultish devotion to every new album.
entries.zh: 他的歌迷对每一张新专辑都表现出狂热的迷恋。

entries.en: Siltation has gradually reduced the depth of the harbour entrance.
entries.zh: 淤积逐渐减小了港口入口的水深。

entries.en: She works fulltime while completing her degree in the evenings.
entries.zh: 她全职工作，同时利用晚上完成学位课程。

entries.en: The review examines who holds decisional authority within the organisation.
entries.zh: 这份审查探讨了组织内由谁掌握决策权。

entries.en: The market stall served slices of boudin with warm bread.
entries.zh: 市场上的摊位供应血肠片和热面包。

entries.en: A jar of Vaseline stood beside the theatrical makeup.
entries.zh: 一罐凡士林放在舞台化妆用品旁。

entries.en: A twangy guitar accompanied the singer's rough voice.
entries.zh: 吉他铮铮的弦声伴着歌手沙哑的嗓音。

entries.en: A drop of superglue held the broken ornament together.
entries.zh: 一滴超强力胶水把破碎的装饰品粘在了一起。

entries.en: The artist carved a second woodblock for the red areas.
entries.zh: 艺术家为红色部分另刻了一块木刻版。

entries.en: The clinic displayed several orthotic devices used in rehabilitation.
entries.zh: 诊所展示了几种康复中使用的矫正装置。

entries.en: We waited at the kerbside until the traffic stopped.
entries.zh: 我们在马路边等候，直到车流停下。

entries.en: They rented a characterful cottage with crooked beams and tiny windows.
entries.zh: 他们租了一间很有特色的小屋，屋里有歪斜的梁和小小的窗户。

entries.en: Much of the collection's value was tied up in illiquid assets.
entries.zh: 这批收藏的大部分价值都体现在难以迅速变现的资产上。

entries.en: She practised the axel repeatedly before attempting it in competition.
entries.zh: 她在比赛中尝试前外一周半跳之前，反复练习了这个动作。

entries.en: He became insufferably smug after winning the office quiz.
entries.zh: 赢了办公室问答比赛后，他得意得让人受不了。

entries.en: The software's misidentification of the symbol changed the final result.
entries.zh: 软件对该符号的错误识别改变了最终结果。

entries.en: The mechanic pointed out the emergency shutoff beside the motor.
entries.zh: 机械师指出了电动机旁的紧急切断装置。

entries.en: The professor emerita still attends the department's weekly seminars.
entries.zh: 那位荣誉退休女教授仍参加系里的每周研讨会。

entries.en: We shared a wedge of Camembert with crusty bread.
entries.zh: 我们就着脆皮面包分吃了一块卡芒贝尔干酪。

entries.meaningZh: 开玩笑的；带游戏意味的
entries.en: The poem's ludic tone conceals a serious question about memory.
entries.zh: 这首诗戏谑的语气下隐藏着一个关于记忆的严肃问题。

entries.en: The anatomy model clearly shows the ischial region of the pelvis.
entries.zh: 解剖模型清楚地展示了骨盆的坐骨区域。

entries.en: In the memoir, a houseboy carries messages between the rooms.
entries.zh: 在这本回忆录中，一名男仆在各个房间之间传递口信。

entries.en: The cursor moved rightward when I pressed the arrow key.
entries.zh: 我按下箭头键时，光标向右移动。

entries.en: The seminar compared a biopsychosocial approach with a narrowly biological one.
entries.zh: 研讨课比较了生物心理社会学方法与单纯的生物学方法。

entries.en: In the thriller, the agent is lethally wounded during the escape.
entries.zh: 在这部惊悚小说中，特工逃跑时受了致命伤。

entries.en: Mud covered the spectators' boots after the motocross event.
entries.zh: 摩托车越野赛结束后，观众的靴子上沾满了泥。

entries.en: Her weblog records the slow restoration of an abandoned house.
entries.zh: 她的网络日志记录了一栋废弃房屋缓慢的修复过程。

entries.en: The microscope image revealed a complex nanostructure within the coating.
entries.zh: 显微图像显示涂层内部有复杂的纳米结构。

entries.en: Her unfussy response to the broken plate put everyone at ease.
entries.zh: 她对打碎盘子并不大惊小怪，让大家都放松了下来。

entries.en: The old bus ended its journey in a crowded scrapyard.
entries.zh: 那辆旧公共汽车最终停在了一个拥挤的废品场里。

entries.en: We rethought the seating plan after three more guests arrived.
entries.zh: 又来了三位客人后，我们重新考虑了座位安排。

entries.en: Her trailblazing research encouraged younger scholars to question accepted methods.
entries.zh: 她开创性的研究鼓励年轻学者质疑公认的方法。

entries.en: The bakery sells pillowy rolls filled with sweet red beans.
entries.zh: 这家面包店卖松软如枕的红豆馅面包卷。

entries.meaningZh: 激烈的争辩〔非正式，贬义〕
entries.en: The editor regretted turning their disagreement into a public catfight.
entries.zh: 编辑后悔把他们的分歧变成了公开的激烈争吵。

entries.en: The technician replaced the damaged isolator before testing the circuit.
entries.zh: 技术员先更换了损坏的隔离器，再测试电路。

entries.en: The documentary follows the formation of a protostar inside a cloud.
entries.zh: 这部纪录片追踪了云团内部一颗原恒星的形成过程。

entries.en: I ordered decaffeinated coffee because it was already late.
entries.zh: 因为时间已经很晚，我点了脱咖啡因的咖啡。

entries.en: The investigator questioned the voluntariness of the signed confession.
entries.zh: 调查人员质疑那份签字供词是否出于自愿。

entries.en: The new leader hoped to be a unifier rather than a partisan.
entries.zh: 新领导人希望成为促进统一的人，而不是党派人士。

entries.en: She raised a finger warningly when the children approached the vase.
entries.zh: 孩子们靠近花瓶时，她警告地竖起一根手指。

entries.en: They ribboned the baskets before filling them with flowers.
entries.zh: 他们先用缎带装饰篮子，再把花装进去。

entries.en: A jojoba grew beside the path through the dry botanical garden.
entries.zh: 干燥的植物园里，一株加州希蒙得木长在小径旁。

entries.en: The script gives the supposedly ditzy character the cleverest final line.
entries.zh: 剧本把最机智的最后一句台词给了那个被认为没头脑的角色。

entries.en: The technician replaced the decentered lens in the optical instrument.
entries.zh: 技术员更换了光学仪器中偏离中心的镜片。

entries.en: The class debated the bioethical questions raised by the experiment.
entries.zh: 全班讨论了这项实验引发的生物伦理学问题。

entries.en: The menu displayed mouthwatering photographs of freshly baked pastries.
entries.zh: 菜单上印着新鲜出炉的酥点照片，让人垂涎欲滴。

entries.en: He poured a small glass of fino before dinner.
entries.zh: 晚餐前，他倒了一小杯淡色干雪利酒。

entries.en: The phoniness of his apology was obvious to everyone present.
entries.zh: 在场的人都看得出，他的道歉很虚假。

entries.en: The essay contrasts government provision with voluntarism in local welfare.
entries.zh: 这篇文章比较了地方福利中的政府供给与志愿主义。

entries.en: After demob, he returned to his family's small printing business.
entries.zh: 复员后，他回到了自家的小印刷厂工作。

entries.en: A narrow passage led leftward from the main corridor.
entries.zh: 一条狭窄通道从主走廊向左延伸。

entries.en: The old boneyard lay behind the ruined village church.
entries.zh: 旧墓地位于村里破败的教堂后面。

entries.en: The historical display included a bar of carbolic soap.
entries.zh: 历史展览中有一块石炭酸皂。

entries.en: In the story, the twins communicate telepathically across the ocean.
entries.zh: 在故事中，这对双胞胎隔着大海通过心灵感应交流。

entries.en: The calculation produces a dimensionless ratio rather than a distance.
entries.zh: 计算得到的是无量纲的比值，而不是距离。

entries.en: She chose a refillable bottle for her daily commute.
entries.zh: 她选择了一个可重复灌装的瓶子用于每天通勤。

entries.en: The gallery displays models of extinct megafauna beside human silhouettes.
entries.zh: 展厅把已灭绝巨型动物的模型与人类剪影并排展示。

entries.en: The director was remembered as a modernizer of the old institution.
entries.zh: 人们记得这位主管使那个老机构实现了现代化。

entries.en: The laboratory records psychophysiological responses while volunteers watch short films.
entries.zh: 实验室记录志愿者观看短片时的心理生理反应。

entries.en: The quiet solo gave way to a brilliant tutti.
entries.zh: 安静的独奏之后，是辉煌的全体合奏。

entries.en: The river became fishable again once the floodwater receded.
entries.zh: 洪水退去后，这条河又适合钓鱼了。

entries.en: A riderless horse trotted past the empty grandstand.
entries.zh: 一匹无人骑的马小跑着经过空荡荡的看台。

entries.en: The report highlights the disproportionality between funding and actual need.
entries.zh: 报告强调了资金与实际需求之间的比例失调。

entries.en: The old fisherman waved the boyo over to his boat.
entries.zh: 老渔夫招手让那个小伙子到船边来。

entries.meaningZh: 不合作的〔英式非正式用语〕
entries.en: He became bolshie when asked to repeat the entire task.
entries.zh: 被要求把整个任务重做一遍时，他变得很不合作。

entries.en: The laboratory measured carnitine in the labelled sample.
entries.zh: 实验室测量了标记样本中的肉碱含量。

entries.en: An elderly hillman guided the travellers along the narrow ridge.
entries.zh: 一位年长的山区居民沿着狭窄山脊给旅人们带路。

entries.en: She placed the clean eyedropper beside the unopened bottle.
entries.zh: 她把干净的眼药水滴管放在尚未打开的瓶子旁。

entries.en: The fictional detective infallibly recognises every voice he has heard before.
entries.zh: 这位虚构侦探能绝对无误地认出所有曾听过的声音。

entries.en: The crime novel follows a narco working undercover at the docks.
entries.zh: 这部犯罪小说讲述了一名缉毒刑警在码头卧底的故事。

entries.en: The staff resented the new schedule imposed by managerial diktat.
entries.zh: 员工们对管理层强行下令实施的新时间表感到不满。

entries.en: The philosophy seminar compared illusionism with competing accounts of reality.
entries.zh: 哲学研讨课把幻想说与其他关于实在的理论进行了比较。

entries.en: The cartoon features a porky little pig wearing enormous boots.
entries.zh: 这幅卡通画画了一只穿着巨大靴子的胖乎乎小猪。

entries.en: The game lets players create a genderless character.
entries.zh: 这款游戏允许玩家创建一个没有性别的角色。

entries.meaningZh: 小旅馆；客栈〔西班牙语借词〕
entries.en: We found a quiet posada overlooking the village square.
entries.zh: 我们找到一家能俯瞰村庄广场的安静客栈。

entries.en: A Twinkie sat beside the child's unfinished sandwich.
entries.zh: 一块奶油夹心蛋糕放在孩子没吃完的三明治旁。

entries.en: The technician recorded the temperature inside the bioreactor.
entries.zh: 技术员记录了生物反应器内部的温度。

entries.en: The drawing shows an eyestalk extending above the crab's shell.
entries.zh: 画中，一根眼柄伸出螃蟹的甲壳上方。
